newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian thieves burn target searching in dark.
newsitem.headline: Algerian thieves burn target searching in dark.

text.p: Five Algerian thieves landed in a neighbouring kitchen instead of the shop in Oran they wanted to rob and set the place ablaze trying to find the light switch.

"We found ourselves in the kitchen of the neighbouring house. Thrust into the darkness, we lit a candle to look for the switch," one of the five men, aged between 20 and 37, told the court in the western Algerian city of Oran on Sunday.
"You forgot to blow out the candle which caused a fire, wrecking the house and the shop," replied the judge, who sentenced them to up to 10 years in jail.
The official Algerian news agency APS said the five shouted in chorus as they were led away that they intended only to rob the cashdesk.
